transcript.content: Cluster 348's top up-regulated markers are: dlb, scrt1b, atoh1a, dla, cdkn1ca, cep131, olig4, gadd45gb.1. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: developing mechanosensory hair cell / hair-cell progenitor, probably neuromast/otic, Notch-active differentiating state.**

## Evidence
- **atoh1a** — expressed in nervous system, otic epithelium/vesicle and neuromast contexts; acts in mechanoreceptor differentiation, matching hair-cell lineage [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-17).
- **atoh1a** — neuromast hair-cell anatomy page lists atoh1a among genes with curated expression figures; neuromast hair cell is a sensory receptor of the neuromast [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0009367).
- **dla** — deltaA is a predicted Notch ligand, expressed in neural plate/tube/nervous system and acts in nervous-system development/regulation of Notch signaling [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29).
- **dla** — curated publication links deltaA to lateral inhibition of inner-ear hair cells, fitting a sensory hair-cell progenitor/differentiation program [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-000201-15).
- **dlb** — deltaB is a Notch-ligand paralog expressed in ectoderm, neural plate, and nervous system; supports a Notch-mediated neural/sensory progenitor context [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114).
- **scrt1b** — expressed in CNS/spinal neural tube; publication summary reports scrt genes overlap differentiating neurons/neuronal precursors, supporting neural differentiation rather than epithelial support fate [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050327-72).
- **olig4** — expressed in nervous system/neural plate/neural tube and acts in regulation of neuron differentiation [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-3580).
- **GO:0042490** — mechanoreceptor differentiation explicitly includes acquisition of mechanoreceptor features and has neuromast hair-cell differentiation as a child term [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0042490).
- **ZFA:0000243** — neuromast is a lateral-line sensory organ containing hair cells and support elements [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0000243).

## Caveats
- Marker set lacks strong mature hair-cell effectors; call is more **progenitor/differentiating** than mature hair cell.
- Otic vs lateral-line neuromast cannot be fully resolved from these markers alone.

**Verdict:** mechanosensory hair-cell progenitor / differentiating hair cell — confidence medium

**Most defensible call: neural/ectodermal sensory progenitor, most consistent with lateral-line/otic hair-cell lineage progenitor; not enough to call mature hair cell.**

## Evidence
- **atoh1a** — strongest sensory-lineage clue: ZFIN says it acts in mechanoreceptor differentiation and is expressed in nervous system, otic epithelium/vesicle, and neural tube; ZFIN neuromast hair-cell anatomy lists **atoh1a** among top expression-linked genes. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-17), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009367)  
- **dla** — Delta/Notch ligand; ZFIN places expression in ectoderm, nervous system, neural keel/plate/tube and function in nervous-system development / Notch regulation, supporting a progenitor/lateral-inhibition context rather than a terminal differentiated identity. [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-29)  
- **dlb** — another Delta ligand, predicted Notch binding; ZFIN expression includes ectoderm, nervous system, neural plate, diencephalon/midbrain development. GO defines Notch signaling as ligand-initiated signaling to regulate downstream processes. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-114), [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0007219)  
- **scrt1b** — neural differentiation support: ZFIN expression in CNS and spinal cord neural tube; curated publication summary says scrt genes overlap differentiating neurons/neuronal precursors. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050327-72), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-110502-2)  
- **cdkn1ca** — supports differentiating/quiescing progenitor state: ZFIN says negative regulation of mitotic cell cycle, cell fate specification, glial differentiation, expression in nervous system/neural tube. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040123-1)  
- **Alternative: generic CNS neuronal progenitor/differentiating neuron** — supported by **scrt1b/dla/dlb/cdkn1ca** neural-tube/CNS expression; weaker than sensory-hair lineage because **atoh1a** plus neuromast/otic evidence points more specifically to mechanosensory programs. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050327-72), [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-17)  
- **Alternative: neuromast support cell** — plausible tissue tier because neuromast is a lateral-line sensory organ containing hair cells and support elements, but current markers lack canonical support-cell evidence; atoh1a favors hair-cell/progenitor side. [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000243), [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009363)  

## Caveats
- No terminal hair-cell markers were provided, so “mature hair cell” is not defensible.
- Deepest safe tier: **neural ectoderm / sensory organ progenitor**, leaning lateral-line/otic hair-cell lineage.

**Verdict:** sensory hair-cell lineage progenitor, progenitor — confidence medium**

The two literature reads and the raw statistics agree on the main interpretation. The decisive markers are not the broad neural/Notch genes alone, but the combination of **atoh1a** and **scrt1b** with strong Delta/Notch signaling.

- **atoh1a** is the best lineage anchor: it is highly enriched in this cluster, with log2FC 2.769, 60.7% in-cluster versus 1.1% out, and rank 1/470 by mean expression. Its curated association with mechanoreceptor/hair-cell differentiation makes the hair-cell-lineage call much stronger than a generic CNS progenitor call.
- **scrt1b** independently supports neural/sensory precursor differentiation and is also very specific: log2FC 2.933, 55.9% in versus 2.9% out, rank 1/470.
- **dlb** and **dla** are very strong in-cluster Delta/Notch markers, but broader across clusters. They support a lateral-inhibition/progenitor or differentiating sensory context rather than defining the cell type alone.
- **cdkn1ca** is extremely strong in-cluster but broad, so it supports cell-cycle exit/differentiation rather than cell identity.

So the settled call is **mechanosensory hair-cell lineage progenitor / differentiating hair cell**, likely otic or lateral-line neuromast, but not mature hair cell because terminal hair-cell effector markers are not in the provided top set.
